# Moru Core v26.44.0

This release provides the verified native runtime and the accumulated runtime
performance changes at `31c97d07584b9e01fb5ae4c9ff6eb6ec1fa31aa9`.
The tag identifies the original build source, not a later installation-guide update.

## Download and install

Download your platform's `moru-native-*.tar.gz` from the release assets.
Release attachments do not use the seven-day Actions artifact retention policy;
they remain downloadable unless explicitly deleted. GitHub login is not required
for public release downloads. Do not unpack the `.tar.gz` yourself.

Use Moru Core source at `v26.44.0`, preserving any existing local edits.
For a new installation only:

```sh
git clone --branch v26.44.0 https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core.git ~/.moru/core
cd ~/.moru/core
python3 scripts/native-runtime-bundle.py install --bundle /path/to/moru-native-macos-arm64.tar.gz
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --dry-run
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py
python3 scripts/setup-agent-hooks.py --check
```

Reuse your existing Core checkout when present instead of automatically cloning
another copy. Select the bundle for your operating system and CPU. Python 3.9+
and Git remain required; receiving computers do not need Rust or Cargo.

The importer checks host, exact native source and executable hashes before
installation. `SHA256SUMS` covers the four complete archives; `BUILD.json`
records original CI source/run and archive hashes. These checks establish
integrity and source matching, not publisher identity: use this trusted release.

## Platforms and verification

- macOS ARM64 and x86_64: target macOS 13+, tested on macOS 15.
- Linux ARM64 and x86_64: built and tested on Ubuntu 24.04; older glibc is unverified.
- Windows is not supported by this POSIX native runtime.

All four jobs in [build 41181962617](https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core/actions/runs/41181962617)
passed behavior checks and fresh-consumer execution without Python/Rust/Cargo/Git
on PATH before uploading these exact archives. The macOS ARM64 archive was also
downloaded, transported and activated on the local receiving computer.
Source verification covered 300 distinct focused tests. No native rebuild was
performed merely to move the verified archives from CI storage to release storage.

## Runtime changes and limits

- Native checkout lookup and shared Claude/Antigravity status rendering, with Python fallback.
- Python discovery enumeration, matching, metadata and registry reuse.
- Deferred status/advisor/mailbox imports and repository identity reuse within a single prompt.
- In one controlled local experiment, quiet prompt delivery fell from 150.023
  to 109.626 ms median. Other paths had small or no gains and some mixed tails.
  This is not a whole-agent, cross-host performance or token-saving claim.

No state schema migration or credential change is required. Existing renderer
chains and Spill connections are preserved. Set `MORU_LAUNCHER_BACKEND=python`
and `MORU_CHECKOUT_IDENTITY_BACKEND=python` for explicit native rollback.

Full source comparison: https://github.com/taehwandev/moru-core/compare/v26.42.0...v26.44.0
